title: A Harvest for the House
author: Lior Thornbury
blurb: Gideon Whitlock, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
